text: I've had this dry cough going on for about three months now. It doesn't bring up any phlegm or blood, but it does make me feel quite winded when I try to play basketball. speaker: Doctor
text: That is helpful context; however, I need to clarify if you have been diagnosed with COPD in the past or if this is a new finding. Additionally, have you noticed any swelling in your legs or sudden weight gain recently?
